company.shortDescription: AI-powered Arabic voice and customer experience solutions for enterprise
company.description: intella builds proprietary Arabic speech intelligence for the enterprise. Our ecosystem includes Ziilá (AI voice agent), intellaCX (call center analytics), intellaMX (Arabic subtitling & transcription), and intellaVX (Arabic speech-to-text API). 95.73% accuracy across 25+ Arabic dialects. Deployed on-premise for banks, telecoms, and enterprises across MENA.

insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.statement: 1 disclosed grants total $50,000, representing 0.29% of reported funding.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $8,930,127 to $66,232,646, a 7.42x increase.
